name: @side-quest/vault-git-transaction-manager
description: Facade-backed transaction boundary for configured Super-vault writes.

scripts.test: bun run test:default && bun run test:smoke && bun run test:live-acceptance && bun run test:pr-public && bun run test:performance
scripts.test:pr: bun run test:fixture-cleanup && bun run test:pr-public && bun run test:performance
scripts.test:pr-public: bun test tests/pr-acceptance/manifest.test.ts --reporter=dots && bun run tests/pr-acceptance/run.ts
scripts.test:live-acceptance: bun test tests/live-acceptance/manifest.test.ts --reporter=dots && bun run tests/live-acceptance/run.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --strict --target ESNext --lib ESNext --module Preserve --moduleDetection force --moduleResolution bundler --allowImportingTsExtensions --verbatimModuleSyntax --skipLibCheck --noFallthroughCasesInSwitch --noImplicitOverride --resolveJsonModule --types bun,node src/*.ts tests/*.ts tests/live-acceptance/*.ts tests/pr-acceptance/*.ts tests/smoke/*.ts
